title: HEALING PRAYER
PSALM 103:1-5
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace

scenes.a: Bring every weary ache and heavy burden before the Father of tender mercies today.
Psalm one hundred and three says, Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness.
For He knoweth our frame and pitieth His children with gentle, unfailing compassion.
Father, renew exhausted strength like the eagle's and quiet every anxious thought in Christ.
Guide every physician and caregiver in wisdom and surround our loved ones with healing peace.
Type Amen and subscribe to The Healing Balm to receive God's healing peace in daily prayer.
